Nithari Case Accused Surendra Koli Found Dead in Haridwar

Surendra Koli, an accused in the Nithari killings case, was found dead in his tea shop in Haridwar. Police suspect suicide, with reports indicating he was found hanging. The Supreme Court had previously set him free. An investigation into the circumstances of his death is underway.
